purpose: Paired B2/B3 forecast-time encounter ablation on the inspected screening regression set

numerical_audit.cases: All four Apophis lead windows and the 180/365-day Apophis main windows
numerical_audit.metrics: Signed distance/time differences of window minima, all nine bodies; no claim of a rigorous error bound

protocol.forecast_inputs: One initial asteroid state, epoch/horizon, fixed constants and daily planetary ephemerides; reference states and known event dates excluded
protocol.forces: B2 solar only; B3 adds existing nine point-mass perturbers with heliocentric direct and indirect terms; no GR, SB16, J2 or fitted NG
protocol.sampling: Uniform daily or six-hour; encounter_steps additionally retains both endpoints of accepted steps where either predicted endpoint lies within fixed 0.01 AU of any perturber
protocol.sampling_limit: The local endpoint guard is not a certified bound against all unseen between-step encounters
protocol.reference: Separate evaluator: identical stored Horizons Hermite window minima and event refinement as the previous screening experiment
protocol.alerts: Unchanged exploratory 0.001/0.01/0.05 AU thresholds, including boundary minima; case/body detection, not event catalogue or safety classification
protocol.cost: Three serial repeats with rotated order; complete initial-state-to-minima cost including force and geometry sampling, resident ephemerides; loading/reference/fine audit separate
protocol.scope: Adding point-mass planetary dynamics is the current subtask. Further weak forces and learned model selection remain separate experiments
